clock_status: Hypothetical common clock for comparing architectures; not a measured or guaranteed operating frequency.
time_definition: Without caching: cycles_per_square * exponent_bits / reference_clock_hz. With cold_start_cycles: (cold_start_cycles + (exponent_bits - 1) * cycles_per_square) / reference_clock_hz. Approximate arithmetic-only time per main PRP candidate, not measured hardware runtime.
targets_status: Chosen 5–10 minute engineering goals, not a matched GPU benchmark or a claim of parity.

milestones.label:
Serial
baseline
milestones.description: Three serial field transforms plus serial CRT and carry. Component-cycle model; excluded several integration overheads.

milestones.label:
Pipelined
integration
milestones.description: Three concurrent field engines, streaming CRT, reciprocal carry and on-chip root generation; full-square control overhead included.

milestones.label:
Remove transform
reordering
milestones.description: Forward DIF and inverse DIT remove both explicit bit-reversal passes.

milestones.label:
Four transform
lanes / field
milestones.description: Four butterflies per cycle in each field, using eight conflict-free memory banks.

milestones.label:
Add prefix
carry handling
milestones.description: Independent coefficient division and bounded five-state carry propagation, with a runtime-checked large-radix domain.

milestones.label:
16 transform + carry
lanes, cached roots
milestones.description: Sixteen butterflies per field and sixteen carry lanes, with root phases retained across squares. Conversion and CRT remain scalar. Projection uses one cold square plus warm squares, assuming no cache-invalidating reset/error. This RTL snapshot is simulation-verified, not physically timing-qualified.

milestones.label:
FAST16
wide I/O + carry
milestones.description: Sixteen-wide conversion, CRT and carry with cached transforms. This chart still assumes100MHz; the separate whole-core fit reports82.28MHz and an80MHz planning projection is about37.7minutes.

milestones.label:
27-bit fields
64 NTT / 16 I/O
milestones.description: Atomic three-field27-bit arithmetic with radix2^32, cached roots and64 transform lanes per field. Full-size correctness and fault gates passed. Whole-core routing is in progress; no completed fit or supported operating clock yet.

milestones.label:
Overlap CRT
and carry (64 lanes)
milestones.description: Separate original-field-basis branch with fused input conversion and ordered CRT-to-carry streaming. Full-size, fault and compatibility gates passed; no completed physical fit. This is not yet the27-bit streaming-precision integration. Transport-interrupted original reports are preserved with SHA-linked successful recovery evidence.

limitations: No FPGA hardware runtime measurements are included.
No complete GFN16 PRP/proof worker has been benchmarked; time is extrapolated from sampled modular squares.
The baseline is a component model; later milestones include conversion, root loading, CRT, carry and controller overhead.
Carry work can be data-dependent; five chained random squares are not a full-PRP average or a universal upper bound.
Cached milestones assume roots stay resident after one cold square. Cache invalidation, resets or errors require additional root loading.
Proof generation, verification, checkpoints and board/host overhead are excluded.
Raw private reports and vendor outputs are intentionally not published. Hashes identify internal evidence, not a publicly reproducible RTL build.
Milestone order is not elapsed development time. Dates use the publication update day; architecture points can belong to separate experimental branches.
The common100MHz chart is not a series of fitted operating clocks. The32,116-cycle point has no completed physical fit; it is not demonstrated10-minute hardware throughput.
